correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the entire-set bijection: independent original vertices form a clique A of G; subdivision vertices are forced exactly for edges disjoint from A; an omitted original vertex v is undominated exactly if N_G(v)=A. Thus admissible cliques index all maximal independent sets, with exponent |A|+m-sum_A degree+binom(|A|,2). The n=1 and K_n boundary cases, empty clique, isolated vertices, and degree-count normalization are consistent. Independent direct graph construction and independent-domination subset enumeration matched the formula for every labeled simple graph on n<=4 (75 graphs). Finite checks corroborate, not prove, the arbitrary-graph bijection.
